verdict.rationale: Rippling documents custom workflow automation, but nothing in the evidence shows versioning, review or approval of workflow changes, or rollback of automations. The CLI's ability to create, manage and deploy integrations is a developer building block for a different subject. Pay-run comparison is an adjacent payroll feature, not automation version control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
